author: horsefighter
quote:
Rockstar had over a decade and a near-unlimited budget, and they gave us the weakest pair of protagonists in the series.
Jason Duval is a cuck in his own game. He has no ambition, no edge and no spine. He drives where he's told, waits where he's told and gets dragged along by a woman who can't run a robbery without ending up in prison. Tommy Vercetti took over Vice City. CJ rebuilt Grove Street. Jason holds the purse and nods. He's a Rockstar protagonist without one memorable line.
